chapters.title: Overview
goals: Summarize what the Ring of Nestor is, its main features, and the central authenticity debate.
chapters.section_plan: Lead-style overview defining the Ring of Nestor, outlining its type, date and cultural attribution, key iconographic features, provenance issues, and the existence of an authenticity dispute.

chapters.title: Discovery and description
goals: Present discovery history, early publication, and physical description of the ring.
chapters.section_plan: Narrative of how and when the ring entered scholarly record, including Evans's work; detailed description of material, measurements, engraving, and current museum catalog data.

chapters.title: Iconography and interpretations
goals: Describe the imagery on the ring and summarize major interpretations over time.
chapters.section_plan: Systematic description of iconographic elements; early interpretations (Evans and contemporaries), followed by later critiques and alternative readings, including Vlachopoulos and recent iconography studies.

chapters.title: Authenticity and dating
goals: Explain the competing views on authenticity, technical and stylistic analyses, and proposed dates.
chapters.section_plan: Account of Evans's original dating and acceptance; later challenges (Pini, Fakes and Dubitanda); technical vs iconographic arguments; museum stance; range of proposed chronologies and cultural attributions.

chapters.title: Archaeological and historical significance
goals: Situate the ring within Aegean Bronze Age art, religion, and Mycenaean studies.
chapters.section_plan: Discussion of how the ring has been used in reconstructions of Minoan-Mycenaean religion and elite display; comparison with other signet rings and with the Griffin Warrior finds; cautionary use in light of authenticity doubts.

chapters.title: Provenance and museum history
goals: Trace ownership, acquisition, cataloguing, and public presentation of the ring.
chapters.section_plan: Summary of reported provenance, acquisition by the Ashmolean, catalog details, and later exhibition or digital representation; note uncertainties and public narratives about its origin.

chapters.title: Scholarly debate and recent research
goals: Synthesize ongoing debates, recent publications, and unresolved issues, including disclosed conflicts.
chapters.section_plan: Overview of major lines of debate (iconography, authenticity, chronology, geographic attribution) with emphasis on post-2000 scholarship; explicit coverage of registered conflicts and methodological discussions.
